title: Processes and signals
intro: A process is a running program. You can list them, run them in the background and send them signals.

steps.text: Show every process with its owner, CPU and memory.
Start a long command in the background with &.
Send it the TERM signal and check it's gone.
Watch processes live. Press <kbd>q</kbd> to quit.
How long has this machine been up, and how busy is it?
